article.body: UK Defence Innovation (UKDI) updates standard terms and conditions for funding and contracts. This policy change affects companies seeking funding from UKDI. The updated terms and conditions are effective from September 23, 2026, as stated in the UKDI Standard Terms and Conditions document published by the Defence and Security Accelerator. Further details can be found in the provided UKDI Standard Terms and Conditions guidance.
